items.q: How long does cooling tower construction take in Japan?
items.a: Timelines depend on the size of the tower, the scope of work and site access. Send us your project details and we will discuss the schedule with your quote.

items.q: Do you service both open-circuit and closed-circuit towers?
items.a: Yes. ICS works on both open-circuit and closed-circuit systems, depending on the facility’s process requirements.

items.q: What standards do your cooling towers meet in Japan?
items.a: Each project is designed to the project specification and to the seismic and building code requirements that apply at the site. Send us your specification and we will confirm the standards for your project.

items.q: Can you supply replacement parts for an existing cooling tower?
items.a: Yes. We supply cooling tower parts including fill media, drift eliminators and fan components for existing towers, including towers we did not install. Send us the tower details or part numbers and we will confirm what we can supply.
